message: 見栄見得

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's up with you? You finished your tests without a hitch, so why're you lettin' out such a gloomy sigh?」

name: Synn
message: 「At Ryuusei Academy, the grade rankings are posted the day after exams.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure don't waste any time. Well, that's probably Helena's educational policy for ya.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I wonder what rank I got this time? I'm a scholarship student, so it'd be bad if I got an embarrassing score...」

name: Shio
message: 「Sneak, sneak...」

name: Shio
message: 「Tip-toe, tip-toe...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, the naginata girl's sneakin' around like a total weirdo.」

name: Shio
message: 「Glance, glance? Now is my chance to flee homeward like a startled hare... Sneak, sneak.」

name: Synn
message: 「Playing hide-and-seek, or maybe tag? Hey there, Shio-chan.」

name: Shio
message: 「E-Eeeek~~~\s01 Somebody save me~~~!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, wait a second!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Shio-chan!」

name: Shio
message: 「I-Impossible!? To think I would be caught by Elder Sister!」

name: Shio
message: 「...Oh, it is merely you, Synn-dono. Pray do not startle me so...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you were acting blatantly suspicious, so I called out to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be you were trying to go home while avoiding Misa?」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh my? Look, five-colored clouds in the sky--」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hmm. If it's hard to talk about, I won't force you to tell me.」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, it is nothing of great consequence.」

name: Shio
message: 「It is merely that... I boasted just a tiny bit to Elder Sister. I declared that I would place within the top ten on this exam...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's one huge boast! In my expert judgment, the naginata girl's a pretty big idiot, ain't she?」

name: Shio
message: 「H-How insolent! I am merely flying low, just slightly below the average score!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan... So, suddenly aiming for the top 10...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's some high difficulty.」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed, I too meant it in jest.」

name: Shio
message: 「The other day, my elder sister came over to stay the night, and it turned into a sisters-only pajama party.」

name: Shio
message: 「Swept up in the lively atmosphere of the moment, my tongue just slipped...」

name: Shio
message: 「Easier said than done. Goodness, a slip of the tongue is truly terrifying.」

name: Synn
message: 「They say a white lie is sometimes necessary, but knowing Misa's personality, that probably won't fly.」

name: Shio
message: 「I-It was not a lie! At the point when I promised my elder sister, it could not yet be said to be untrue, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「For example, there was also the possibility that every single first-year, save for myself and nine others, would catch a cold and be absent.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like hell that'd happen!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Nugugugu...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa isn't a demon either. If you show her how hard you tried, Shio-chan, I'm sure she'll understand.」

name: Synn
message: 「The rankings get posted tomorrow, right? Are you confident? Of course, I won't ask for anything crazy like the top 10.」

name: Shio
message: 「Mhm, I will certainly rank lower than last time!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is that something you say while puffing out a flat chest full of confidence?」

name: Shio
message: 「Kiii!! Though they may not measure up to my elder sister's, they have swelled at least a little!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shio-chan, what are you planning to do? Even if you can bluff your way through today and tomorrow, Misa will find out eventually.」

name: Shio
message: 「Well now, that is the problem.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't talk about it like it's someone else's business.」

name: Shio
message: 「Kuuuh! What on earth should I do?」

name: Synn
message: 「For starters, when you go home, I think you'll actually be harder to spot if you don't sneak around and just act confident instead?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's the point of teaching her tricks to evade the law?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well then, what else am I supposed to say?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave it to yours truly.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm. Does the spirit have some brilliant plan, perhaps?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like hell I do, give it up.」

name: Shio
message: 「How vexing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa... Well, it's a matter between sisters, so Paqy and I can't really butt in.」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I thank you for your counsel.」

name: Shio
message: 「Having it stated so plainly has settled my resolve. I, too, am a shrine maiden of Asukai. I shall turn myself in with grace!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo Hisu, nice weather we're having!」

name: Shio
message: 「Eeeek!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So fast!? I mean, she's not mentally prepared at all...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh...」
